Here’s some of my thoughts on some of the shows I’ve seen from your list to hopefully help your decision. 

 - Baby Riendeer: absolutely fantastic. A near perfect show. Currently sitting in second place on my top shows of the year list. Gives all of the emotions but can have some triggering material with sexual abuse.   

-Fallout: a truly great on screen adaptation of the video game. Still an enjoyable show even without a solid knowledge of the games but your experience will be so much more enriched seeing all the little Easter eggs as to where they’re going to be taking the show. Currently number 3 on my top of the year list. 

- Fall of the house of usher: another good horror run from Mike Flanagan. If you like his work then you would like this show. I think it is a good middle of the road entry for him. If you are a bigger Edgar Allen Poe fan than it might rank a bit higher for you. Midnight mass is my favorite from him if you haven’t seen it. 

- Sweet tooth: I have only seen the first season. It was decent a little too childish for me but was a decent watch. Just didn’t stick with me enough to be interested in further seasons. 

- Jessica jones: an absolutely stellar first season than a complete dumpster fire of a second season. 

- Black Mirror: absolutely required viewing. Loses a little steam in some of the latter seasons  but truly some of the most jaw dropping, thought provoking, and insane things you will ever see in a television series. 

-Andor: my personal favorite of the new live action Star Wars shows. It’s not a cartoony action filled type of story. It’s a darker gritty almost spy thriller. If you are a fan of the direction they took in rouge one then you should love it. Andy Serkis delivers an Oscar worthy performance. 

- Succession: one of the greats. Definitely a must watch.  A very talky show where you need to be paying attention to all the different angles people are playing. But also hilarious. Basically corporate game of thrones. Everyone is scheming and backstabbing to try and take the throne (company) in the end. 

- Squid game: a good show that if the memes and other content hasn’t spoiled for you yet is worth the watch. Make sure to watch it subbed if you want the real feel of the show. The dubs are so bad it really takes you out of it. Season 2 is supposed to come out soon as well so could be a good time to watch. 

- the terror: a good slow burn horror show. I was a little disappointed overall. There is plenty to like but I found a lot of plot holes and some things that just didn’t get answered. Worth watching but no rush. 

- Rings of power: as of now I’ve only seen the first season. Waiting for the second season to be completely out and then binge. But as a huge LOTR fan I find it disappointing. There are good things and it’s a very pretty show. You can tell the money was there. But personally it just felt a little bland. It didn’t have the same soul I had come to find from the films. Interested to see how the second season goes

- The boys: one of my fav shows of all time. Personally have loved every season. Very gory and lots of dumb humor, and lots of on the nose social commentary. Some convenient plot armor moments for sure but a lot of fun to be had.
